verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Searching your mail," so mail search exists, but the pack gives only the title, with no detail on query operators, filtering, ranking, speed, or whether search covers the full mail history. This is a single thin mention, so most of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented search operators and filter syntax, evidence of ranked results, evidence of search speed or precision, confirmation that search spans full mail history, independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
